name: Raydium

requiredConfig.name: Raydium SDK
requiredConfig.description: @raydium-io/raydium-sdk-v2 is loaded by the MCP Raydium adapter when first-class reads or prepared actions are used. Tests may inject a Raydium client factory.

readCapabilities.returns: Raydium CPMM, CLMM, or AMM v4 pool facts.
Wallet-owned Raydium CLMM positions, CPMM LP balances for a supplied pool, and farm LP deposits for a supplied farm.
One Raydium CLMM position with tick range, liquidity, fees, rewards, and warnings.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to add CPMM liquidity or add/open CLMM liquidity.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium liquidity transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to remove CPMM LP liquidity or decrease CLMM liquidity.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium remove-liquidity transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to collect fees from a Raydium CLMM position.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium CLMM fee-collection transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to stake LP tokens into a Raydium farm.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium farm deposit transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to unstake LP tokens from a Raydium farm.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium farm withdraw transaction.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A wallet-approval inbox item to harvest Raydium farm rewards.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A freshly rebuilt Raydium farm harvest transaction.

requiredUserInputs.name: poolId
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Raydium pool id should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: poolType
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Is this Raydium pool CPMM, CLMM, or AMM v4?

requiredUserInputs.name: positionMint
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Raydium CLMM position mint should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: farmId
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Raydium farm id should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: amount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much should I prepare for this Raydium action?

requiredConnectorFacts: Pool id, pool type, program id, and token pair
Exact token amounts or liquidity percentage before preparing wallet approval
CLMM range and in-range status for ranged liquidity
Farm id, LP mint, and reward mint facts for farm stake, unstake, or harvest
Configured slippage cap and wallet approval boundary
unsupportedRequests: Create permissioned pools or administer pools.
Guarantee APY, rewards, or impermanent-loss safety.
actionPreparationNotes: Raydium first-class actions stage durable approval inbox items and refresh SDK state when the user executes the prepared action. The adapter never signs, submits, or grants delegated authority by itself.
riskNotes: Raydium AMM, CPMM, CLMM, and farm actions can create price, range, reward, slippage, and impermanent-loss exposure. Display pool/farm facts and exact approval parameters before wallet approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: Raydium actions are first-class prepared wallet approvals. The connector can prepare and rebuild the transaction, but only the user's wallet signs.

requests.agentResponse: Read Raydium pool facts as JSON without signing.

requests.user: add liquidity to this Raydium CPMM pool
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Raydium add-liquidity approval. This does not sign or submit.
Prepared a Raydium fee-collection approval. This does not sign or submit.

requests.user: harvest rewards from this Raydium farm
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Raydium harvest approval. This does not sign or submit.
The agent denied this because it cannot guarantee yield or safety.

mirrorsCanonical.note: Mirrors Raydium browser catalog support for first-class prepared actions and reads.
